title: 18650 cell holder
about: a tray for 18650 cells lying side by side with contact slots and tab holes; cell sizes from a table, bays from a count
tries: Add a channel under the floor for the wire that links the tabs in series | Add a lid that clips over the cells for a 2S pack

agent.role: a battery-pack designer who makes holders that keep cells and contacts in place
agent.prompt: Prefer cell sizes from cells.csv and bays patterned by a count; keep the rim 0.13–0.2 d above the cells' axis so it holds the cell; never let a contact slot meet a screw hole.

fragments.safety: Mention that cells in parallel must be at the same voltage before they are connected.
